titles.text: Pivotal IDE Clinical Investigation of the Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) System in Symptomatic Severe Aortic Stenosis (ISO 14155 / FDA 21 CFR 812)

studyInterventions.name: Vascular Dynamics TAVR System
studyInterventions.description: Self-expanding bioprosthetic aortic valve with a transfemoral delivery catheter.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Severe aortic stenosis
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Severe aortic stenosis: aortic valve area of 1.0 cm2 or less, or a mean gradient of 40 mmHg or more, on echocardiography.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Symptoms
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: NYHA functional class II or higher.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Transfemoral access
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Iliofemoral anatomy suitable for transfemoral delivery, confirmed by CT angiography.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Bicuspid valve
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Congenital bicuspid or unicuspid aortic valve.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Recent stroke
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Stroke or transient ischaemic attack within 6 months before the index procedure.

estimands.name: Primary estimand
estimands.description: Rate of the VARC-3 early safety composite within 30 days of the index procedure in participants in whom implantation was attempted.
estimands.populationSummary: Proportion of participants with a composite event within 30 days, with a two-sided 95% exact (Clopper-Pearson) confidence interval; the performance goal is met when the upper limit is below the fictional performance goal of 20%.

intercurrentEvents.name: Death before day 30
intercurrentEvents.text: Death from any cause within 30 days of the index procedure.

intercurrentEvents.name: Valve not implanted
intercurrentEvents.text: The procedure is attempted but no study valve remains in place at its end, including conversion to surgery.

intercurrentEvents.name: No 30-day assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: The participant has no 30-day visit and no composite event before withdrawal or loss to follow-up.

objectives.name: Primary safety objective
objectives.text: To evaluate the early safety of the TAVR System.

endpoints.name: VARC-3 early safety composite
endpoints.text: VARC-3 early safety composite at 30 days: all-cause death, any stroke, VARC type 2 to 4 bleeding, major vascular, access-related or cardiac structural complication, acute kidney injury stage 3 or 4, moderate or severe aortic regurgitation, new permanent pacemaker due to procedure-related conduction disturbance, or surgery or intervention related to the device. Events are adjudicated by the clinical events committee.

objectives.name: Valve performance objective
objectives.text: To evaluate the haemodynamic performance of the study valve over one year.

endpoints.name: Mean gradient and valve area at 1 year
endpoints.text: Mean transvalvular gradient and effective orifice area on echocardiography at 1 year.

population.name: Study population
population.description: Adults aged 65 or older with symptomatic severe aortic stenosis whose heart team considers them suitable for transfemoral TAVR.
